lines.speaker: isla
lines.text: Good evening and welcome to Hearts News 24. We are live in the studio with all the latest build-up ahead of our European clash in Turkey.

lines.speaker: fraser
lines.text: Hearts manager Wouter Vrancken insists it will take a complete team effort to handle Mo Salah and Trabzonspor in the Conference League.

graphic.title: Wouter Vrancken bullish on Mo Salah as Hearts boss names real Trabzonspor threat

lines.speaker: isla
lines.text: The Jambos have left two players in Edinburgh as they deal with injury concerns ahead of tomorrow night's fixture.

graphic.title: Hearts leave two players in Edinburgh as management explain reason for injury issues ahead of Trabzonspor tie

lines.speaker: fraser
lines.text: Financial figures show that Hearts and Celtic are set to net significant boosts to their bank balances from their European campaigns.

graphic.title: Rangers brutal financial reality of Euro flop becomes clear as Celtic and Hearts UEFA nest eggs rocket

segments.title: Wouter Vrancken bullish on Mo Salah as Hearts boss names real Trabzonspor threat
segments.strap: Wouter Vrancken bullish on Mo Salah as Hearts boss names real…

lines.speaker: isla
lines.text: Fraser Lennox joins us to discuss Wouter Vrancken's pre-match comments in Turkey. Fraser, how is the manager viewing the challenge against Trabzonspor?

graphic.title: Wouter Vrancken bullish on Mo Salah as Hearts boss names real Trabzonspor threat

lines.speaker: fraser
lines.text: Writing in the Daily Record, Scott Burns reports that Vrancken has highlighted Liverpool legend Mo Salah as a major threat. However, the manager stresses that the entire Turkish side possesses world class quality and requires a disciplined team performance.

graphic.text: For sure, it has to be a team effort. You cannot only focus on Salah because he is not the only one with quality
graphic.author: Wouter Vrancken

lines.speaker: isla
lines.text: And how is the squad responding following that heavy defeat to Celtic at the weekend?

lines.speaker: fraser
lines.text: Vrancken admitted the defensive display at Parkhead was nowhere near good enough. The squad has arrived in Trabzon in a bullish mood, determined to learn from those mistakes while staying true to their tactical principles.

lines.speaker: isla
lines.text: Let us head over to the Match Centre where Kirsty Moffat has all the key numbers and fixtures.

lines.speaker: kirsty
lines.text: Celtic seven-one Hearts

lines.speaker: kirsty
lines.text: Third in the Scottish Premiership with sixteen points after nine games, four points behind Rangers in second

lines.speaker: kirsty
lines.text: Trabzonspor against Hearts, UEFA Conference League, tomorrow at 5:45pm

segments.title: Rangers brutal financial reality of Euro flop becomes clear as Celtic and Hearts UEFA nest eggs rocket
segments.strap: Rangers brutal financial reality of Euro flop becomes clear as Celtic…

lines.speaker: isla
lines.text: Fraser, we are also looking at the financial impact of European football across the Scottish Premiership.

graphic.title: Rangers brutal financial reality of Euro flop becomes clear as Celtic and Hearts UEFA nest eggs rocket

lines.speaker: fraser
lines.text: That is right. According to figures calculated by Football Meets Data and reported by the Daily Record, Celtic and Hearts are enjoying bumper European nest eggs. Hearts are set to bank a total of five million two hundred and ninety thousand pounds from their Conference League campaign.

lines.speaker: isla
lines.text: How does that compare to our domestic rivals?

lines.speaker: fraser
lines.text: Rangers are facing a stark financial reality after missing out on league phase football this term. They will earn less from UEFA this season than both Hibs and Motherwell following their early playoff exits.

lines.speaker: ally
lines.text: Welcome to the Transfer Centre. The transfer window is currently closed and reopens in seventy-two days.

segments.title: The Trabzonspor reaction to Hearts hammering by Celtic as boss relates to Parkhead pain
segments.strap: The Trabzonspor reaction to Hearts hammering by Celtic as boss…

lines.speaker: isla
lines.text: Kirsty Moffat is taking a closer look at the opposition camp. Kirsty, what are they saying about us in Turkey?

graphic.title: The Trabzonspor reaction to Hearts hammering by Celtic as boss relates to Parkhead pain

lines.speaker: kirsty
lines.text: Writing in the Daily Record, Scott Burns notes that Trabzonspor boss Thomas Reis is expecting a strong reaction from Hearts following our defeat against Celtic. Reis believes that heavy loss makes the Jambos dangerous opponents at Papara Park.

graphic.text: First of all, it could be a danger if we think they had a big defeat
graphic.author: Thomas Reis

lines.speaker: isla
lines.text: What has Reis said about his own team's approach to the match?

lines.speaker: kirsty
lines.text: Reis has enjoyed a four-match winning start since taking charge. While acknowledging the attention surrounding Mo Salah, the German coach insists success is built on collective team spirit and expects a tough tactical battle against our high press.

lines.speaker: fraser
lines.text: Supporters are feeling a mix of anxiety following the recent domestic result and cautious optimism ahead of the trip to Turkey. Discussions are also busy regarding ticket demand for the upcoming League Cup semi-final.

lines.speaker: isla
lines.text: That is all for this edition. Our rolling coverage here on Hearts News 24 continues right through the night.
